events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Buzz
angles.copy: Still rocking it with that signature swagger. Liam Gallagher turns 54 today. What's your favourite anthem from the Manchester legend?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, 'Imagine', which features his enduring signature song, was released in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album, released in 1971, continues to be a powerful anthem for peace and unity across the globe.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: International James Bond Day celebrates the enduring film franchise, marking the anniversary of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', premiering in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating decades of espionage, iconic characters, and unforgettable theme tunes. What's your pick for the greatest Bond moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles and peace activist, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The celebrated British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: He's not dead yet! John Cleese turns 87 today. A true titan of British comedy, from Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his humour is timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles released their experimental and diverse self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album's Legacy
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped 58 years ago today. An ambitious, genre-spanning masterpiece that proved the Fab Four were still pushing boundaries.

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Commemorating the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who died on this day in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice, stage presence, and legacy remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic progression for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Evolution
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw the band evolve their sound into new, groundbreaking territory.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon, a global icon of music and peace, who died on this day in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Vision
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who tragically passed away 46 years ago. His vision for a better world lives on through his music.
